title: 색깔: 빨간색, 파란색, 하얀색
objective: By the end, you can name basic colors in Korean, ask "무슨 색이에요?" and answer in a short sentence.
summary: Learn seven basic Korean color words (plus 색 and 무슨 색) and use them to describe clothes, things and people around you.

task.title: Use the color words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, write or put in order the right Korean words.

words.exampleMeaning: How about this color? (e.g., when shopping)
I have a lot of black shoes.
I bought a white shirt yesterday.
The traffic light is green. Let's cross.

words.meaning: brown (often used for hair and eyes)

exercises: Choose the right word: 바나나는 (빨간색 / 노란색)이에요.
Fill in the blank: 겨울에 눈이 왔어요. 눈은 ____이에요.
Write the usual color of each thing in Korean: ① 딸기 ② 바다 ③ 초콜릿
Your friend asks, "무슨 색을 좋아해요?" You like green. Answer in a full Korean sentence.
Put the words in order: 검은색 / 바지를 / 입었어요 / 저는
Fill in the blank: 가: 고양이가 무슨 ____이에요? 나: 검은색이에요.
answers: ① 빨간색 ② 파란색 ③ 갈색
